the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.next: Reduce measured Pixman card tracking cost, rerun the fixed card workload, then record real-finger acceptance on the normal image.
the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.rationale: The committed board cost trace misses the frame budget; checked implementation tasks do not establish a default, finger-accepted card shell.

the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.next: Run the remaining exact-image RVV/QEMU and reserved-board checks; keep the normal image unchanged until evidence passes.
the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.rationale: The committed source and build evidence covers the first five tasks, while later target and physical gates remain unchecked.

the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.next: Integrate live deck, launcher artwork, Settings and notification surfaces, then verify the complete shell on glass before checking the capability tasks.
the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.rationale: The icon resolver is a source checkpoint, but the 27-task coherent-shell capability and its named consumers remain open.

the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.next: Finish full generated-token and client, icon and background integration; check service compatibility, then verify theme selection and persistence on the board.
the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.rationale: The three helper and source-fixture tasks are checked. A host-tested opt-in launcher receiver, public selection command, cached startup and pinned default are source and cross-build checkpoints; normal configuration remains off, other consumers and physical selection remain open.

the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.next: Resolve target format and presentation costs, then repeat paired GPU-versus-Pixman acceptance on the board before any default change.
the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.rationale: A committed GPU trial exists, but the comparison did not establish a faster accepted default compositor path.
